title: The board
author: claude
summary: Cork background, pinned cards, arrows and red strings, with zoom, pan, minimap, search and filters.
what: The board page: cards for topics, steps and sub-tasks, drawn on cork, with a key that explains the lines.
why: Part of making the dev log easier to read.
how: Zoom, pan, a minimap, a Fit view button, search, and filters for outcome, area and tag. Light and dark themes, with a darker cork in dark mode.

tech.name: React Flow
tech.plain: Draws the board and lets you zoom, pan and drag the cards.
